title: JPMorgan Chase extends lead as world's most AI-advanced bank
summary: JPMorgan Chase has extended its lead as the world's most artificial intelligence-advanced bank, once again topping the Evident AI Index.
content: JPMorgan Chase has successfully extended its lead as the world's most artificial intelligence-advanced bank. The institution once again secured the top position in the latest Evident AI Index, reinforcing its dominance in adopting and integrating advanced AI technologies within the global financial sector.
content_ta: உலகின் மிகவும் AI-அட்வான்ஸ்டு வங்கி என்ற தனது முதலிடத்தை JPMorgan Chase மேலும் நீட்டித்துள்ளது. Evident AI Index-ல் இந்த நிறுவனம் மீண்டும் முதலிடம் பிடித்துள்ளது.

title: M&A intelligence platform Comparables.ai raises $6m
summary: Finnish mergers and acquisitions intelligence platform Comparables.ai has raised $6 million in seed funding.
content: Finnish mergers and acquisitions intelligence platform Comparables.ai has successfully raised $6 million in seed funding. The company provides advanced market data and insights designed to streamline the M&A process. This new capital injection will enable the platform to accelerate its product development efforts, expand its team, and scale its operations across target markets to meet growing demand.
content_ta: Finnish M&A intelligence platform ஆன Comparables.ai, seed funding-ல் $6 மில்லியன் திரட்டியுள்ளது. இந்நிறுவனம் M&A செயல்முறையை எளிதாக்கும் மேம்பட்ட சந்தை தரவு மற்றும் நுண்ணறிவுகளை வழங்குகிறது. இந்த புதிய முதலீடு, தயாரிப்பு மேம்பாட்டை விரைவுபடுத்தவும், அதன் குழுவை விரிவுபடுத்தவும், வளர்ந்து வரும் தேவையை பூர்த்தி செய்ய சந்தைகளில் அதன் செயல்பாடுகளை அளவிடவும் உதவும்.

title: Open USD supply hits $666 million as 10 wallets trap most tokens
summary:
Crystal’s October 5 snapshot found $396 million unmoved in eight Tempo wallets, while customer activity inside custody accounts remains unknown.
The post Open USD supply hits $666 million as 10 wallets trap most tokens appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: The total supply of Open USD has reached $666 million, with a small number of wallets holding the vast majority of the tokens. A recent analysis revealed that a significant portion of these tokens remained unmoved across several wallets, while customer activity within custody accounts continues to be unclear.
content_ta: Open USD-யின் மொத்த சப்ளை $666 மில்லியன் மதிப்பை எட்டியுள்ளது, இதில் மிகக் குறைந்த எண்ணிக்கையிலான வாலெட்டுகள் பெரும்பான்மையான டோக்கன்களை வைத்துள்ளன. பல வாலெட்டுகளில் இந்த டோக்கன்களில் பெரும்பகுதி நகர்த்தப்படாமல் உள்ளதாக சமீபத்திய ஆய்வு ஒன்று வெளிப்படுத்தியுள்ளது, அதே நேரத்தில் கஸ்டடி கணக்குகளுக்குள்ளான வாடிக்கையாளர் செயல்பாடு தெளிவாகத் தெரியவில்லை.

title: Quantum-proof network Quantus debuts its QTC token on Near – Details
summary: Will QTC ride on the privacy and quantum narrative like Zcash?
content: Quantum-proof network Quantus has officially launched its QTC token on the Near blockchain. This development draws attention from the crypto community regarding its potential focus on privacy and quantum-resistant narratives, similar to other privacy-centric tokens like Zcash.
content_ta: குவாண்டம்-ப்ரூஃப் நெட்வொர்க் ஆன Quantus, தனது QTC டோக்கனை Near பிளாக்செயினில் அதிகாரப்பூர்வமாக அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த வளர்ச்சியானது Zcash போன்ற பிற தனியுரிமை டோக்கன்களைப் போலவே, தனியுரிமை மற்றும் குவாண்டம்-எதிர்ப்பு அம்சங்களில் கவனம் செலுத்துமா என்ற எதிர்பார்ப்பை crypto சமூகத்தினரிடையே ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளது.

title: US government moves $103M in crypto, including 833 BTC and 40,285 BNB
summary:
The US government's crypto movements highlight strategic asset management, with Bitcoin held long-term and BNB potentially liquidated, impacting market dynamics.
The post US government moves $103M in crypto, including 833 BTC and 40,285 BNB appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: The US government recently transferred $103 million in cryptocurrency, comprising 833 BTC and 40,285 BNB. This strategic movement of digital assets suggests different handling approaches for various tokens, with some held for the long term and others potentially facing liquidation, which could impact overall market dynamics.
content_ta: அமெரிக்க அரசு சமீபத்தில் 103 மில்லியன் டாலர் மதிப்பிலான crypto-வை மாற்றியுள்ளது. இதில் 833 BTC மற்றும் 40,285 BNB அடங்கும். டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துக்களின் இந்த நடவடிக்கை சந்தை இயக்கவியலில் தாக்கத்தை ஏற்படுத்தக்கூடும்.

title: Black Hills commits $1.8 billion to power Google’s Cheyenne data center
summary:
The deal highlights the growing demand for dedicated power in tech, potentially setting a precedent for future utility-tech partnerships.
The post Black Hills commits $1.8 billion to power Google’s Cheyenne data center appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Black Hills has committed $1.8 billion to power Google’s Cheyenne data center. This major agreement underscores the rapidly growing demand for dedicated energy solutions within the technology sector and could establish a significant precedent for upcoming partnerships between utility providers and tech giants.
content_ta: Google-ன் Cheyenne டேட்டா சென்டருக்கு மின்சாரம் வழங்குவதற்காக Black Hills நிறுவனம் 1.8 பில்லியன் டாலர்களை ஒதுக்கியுள்ளது. இந்த ஒப்பந்தமானது தொழில்நுட்பத்துறையில் பிரத்யேக மின்சாரத்திற்கான தேவையின் உயர்வை வெளிப்படுத்துவதுடன், எதிர்காலத்திலான utility மற்றும் tech நிறுவனங்களின் கூட்டுறவுகளுக்கு ஒரு முன்னோடியாகவும் அமையும்.

title: Unknown whale moves approximately 133.78 million USDC to Aave
summary:
The large USDC movements into Aave highlight the growing influence of anonymous capital flows in DeFi, impacting liquidity dynamics.
The post Unknown whale moves approximately 133.78 million USDC to Aave appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: An unknown whale has transferred approximately 133.78 million USDC to Aave. This large movement of stablecoins into the decentralized finance platform highlights the increasing influence of anonymous capital flows and their potential impact on liquidity dynamics within the market.
content_ta: ஒரு அறியப்படாத whale தோராயமாக 133.78 மில்லியன் USDC தொகையை Aave-க்கு மாற்றியுள்ளது. DeFi தளத்திற்குள் ஸ்டேபிள்காயின்கள் செல்லும் இந்த பெரிய நகர்வு, அறியப்படாத மூலதனப் பாய்ச்சலின் வளர்ந்து வரும் தாக்கத்தையும் சந்தைக்குள் அதன் பணப்புழக்க இயக்கவியலையும் எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

title: Taiwan emerges as the stronger AI trade bet over South Korea
summary:
Taiwan's AI trade dominance highlights the risks of economic over-reliance on tech sectors amid geopolitical tensions and market volatility.
The post Taiwan emerges as the stronger AI trade bet over South Korea appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Taiwan has emerged as a stronger AI trade bet compared to South Korea, highlighting the region's dominant role in the technology sector. However, this growing dominance also brings attention to potential risks concerning economic over-reliance on tech amid ongoing geopolitical tensions and broader market volatility.
content_ta: South Korea-ஐ விட Taiwan வலுவான AI வர்த்தக பந்தயமாக உருவெடுத்துள்ளது, இது தொழில்நுட்ப துறையில் இப்பகுதியின் ஆதிக்கத்தை எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது. இருப்பினும், புவிசார் அரசியல் மற்றும் சந்தை கொந்தளிப்பு மத்தியில் தொழில்நுட்பத் துறையை அளவுக்கு அதிகமாக நம்பியிருப்பதன் அபாயங்களையும் இது சுட்டிக்காட்டுகிறது.

title: Boston Dynamics names former Amazon Alexa leader Rohit Prasad as CEO
summary:
Prasad's leadership could accelerate Boston Dynamics' shift from innovative robotics to scalable industrial solutions, impacting global automation.
The post Boston Dynamics names former Amazon Alexa leader Rohit Prasad as CEO appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Boston Dynamics has appointed Rohit Prasad, a former Amazon Alexa leader, as its new CEO. His leadership is expected to accelerate the company's transition from developing innovative robotics to providing scalable industrial solutions, which will likely have a significant impact on the global automation sector.
content_ta: Boston Dynamics நிறுவனம், முன்னாள் Amazon Alexa தலைவர் Rohit Prasad-ஐ தனது புதிய CEO-வாக நியமித்துள்ளது. இவரது தலைமைத்துவமானது, நிறுவனம் தனது புதுமையான ரோபாட்டிக்ஸ் தயாரிப்புகளை அளவிடக்கூடிய தொழில்துறை தீர்வுகளாக மாற்றுவதை விரைவுபடுத்துவதோடு, உலகளாவிய ஆட்டோமேஷன் துறையிலும் குறிப்பிடத்தக்க தாக்கத்தை ஏற்படுத்தும் என்று எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது.

title: Bitcoin.de trading remains halted as German regulator rejects MiCA application
summary: Trading on the platform has largely been suspended since June as its operator awaited MiCA authorization, with the company now looking to regulated partners to restart services.
content: Bitcoin.de trading remains suspended after German regulators rejected the platform's MiCA application. Trading has been largely halted since June while the operator awaited authorization. The company is now seeking regulated partners to help restart its services in compliance with regulatory standards.
content_ta: German regulator-ன் MiCA application நிராகரிக்கப்பட்டதால், Bitcoin.de-ல் trading தொடர்ந்து suspend செய்யப்பட்டுள்ளது. Authorization-க்காக காத்திருந்ததால் கடந்த June முதல் trading largely suspend செய்யப்பட்டுள்ளது. Services-ஐ மீண்டும் தொடங்க regulated partners-ஐ அந்த company தேடி வருகிறது.

title: SEC drops to 2 members, and 1 hidden rule shifts crypto power
summary:
The new exception permits one eligible commissioner to form a quorum when every other sitting member is disqualified from the particular matter.
The post SEC drops to 2 members, and 1 hidden rule shifts crypto power appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: The SEC has dropped to just two members, while a newly highlighted exception allows a single eligible commissioner to form a quorum. This rule applies when all other sitting members are disqualified from a specific matter, effectively shifting regulatory power and decision-making capabilities within the agency during critical votes involving the cryptocurrency sector.
content_ta: SEC-ல் தற்போது இரண்டு உறுப்பினர்கள் மட்டுமே உள்ள நிலையில், ஒரு புதிய விதிவிலக்கு மூலம் தகுதியான ஒரு கமிஷனர் மட்டுமே கோரம் (quorum) அமைக்க முடியும் என்று அறிவிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. குறிப்பிட்ட விவகாரத்தில் மற்ற உறுப்பினர்கள் அனைவரும் தகுதி நீக்கம் செய்யப்படும்போது இந்த விதி பொருந்தும். இது கிரிப்டோ துறை தொடர்பான முக்கிய வாக்கெடுப்புகளின் போது ஒழுங்குமுறை அதிகாரத்தை மாற்றியமைக்கிறது.

title: Decoding Zcash’s pullback as Grayscale interest and spot buying grow
summary: Zcash attracts institutional attention and fresh whale accumulation as ZEC finds support after its retracement.
content: Zcash is experiencing renewed market interest following a recent price retracement. The privacy-focused cryptocurrency is seeing increased institutional attention through Grayscale, alongside growing spot buying and fresh whale accumulation. As ZEC establishes solid support levels, market participants are closely monitoring these accumulation trends and growing institutional involvement for potential future momentum.
content_ta: சமீபத்திய விலை சரிவுக்குப் பிறகு Zcash சந்தையில் மீண்டும் புதிய கவனம் பெற்று வருகிறது. கிரேஸ்கேல் (Grayscale) மூலமாக நிறுவன முதலீட்டாளர்களின் ஈர்ப்பும், ஸ்பாட் வாங்குதலும், பெரிய முதலீட்டாளர்களின் (whales) பங்களிப்பும் இதில் அதிகரித்து வருகிறது. ZEC தனது ஆதரவு நிலைகளை உறுதிப்படுத்தி வருவதால், சந்தை வர்த்தகர்கள் இந்த நகர்வுகளைக் தீவிரமாகக் கவனித்து வருகின்றனர்.

title: S&P 500 Breaks Records But Analysts Split on Whether Rally Can Broaden
summary:
The S&P 500 record high above 7,800 splits money managers on whether the rally can broaden beyond big tech and Fed hikes.
The post S&P 500 Breaks Records But Analysts Split on Whether Rally Can Broaden appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: The S&P 500 recently reached a new record high above 7,800 points. However, financial analysts and money managers remain divided on whether this strong market rally can successfully expand beyond major technology stocks. Market participants are closely watching economic developments, including potential Federal Reserve rate hikes, to determine the future trajectory of the broader stock market.
content_ta: S&P 500 சமீபத்தில் 7,800 புள்ளிகளைத் தாண்டி புதிய சாதனை படைத்துள்ளது. இருப்பினும், இந்த சந்தை உயர்வு பெரிய tech பங்குகளுக்கு அப்பால் விரிவடையுமா என்பது குறித்து analists மற்றும் money managers இடையே கருத்து வேறுபாடு நிலவுகிறது. பங்குச் சந்தையின் எதிர்கால போக்கை தீர்மானிக்க Fed rate hikes போன்ற பொருளாதார மாற்றங்களை சந்தை வல்லுநர்கள் தீவிரமாக கண்காணித்து வருகின்றனர்.

title: Goldman Sachs Says China Biotech Is Where Big Pharma Is Shopping Now
summary:
Goldman Sachs analyst Salveen Richter says big pharma is shopping in China biotech as $440 billion in drugs lose patents.
The post Goldman Sachs Says China Biotech Is Where Big Pharma Is Shopping Now appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Goldman Sachs reports that major pharmaceutical companies are increasingly looking to China's biotech sector for new opportunities. This trend is driven by a massive wave of upcoming drug patent expirations, pushing big pharma to seek innovative partnerships and acquisitions in the region to maintain their pipelines.
content_ta: பெரும்பாலான பெரிய ஃபார்மா நிறுவனங்கள் புதிய வாய்ப்புகளுக்காக China-வின் biotech துறையை அதிகளவில் நாடுகின்றன என Goldman Sachs தெரிவித்துள்ளது. வரவிருக்கும் மருந்து காப்புரிமை காலாவதி காரணமாக, இந்த பெருநிறுவனங்கள் தங்கள் தயாரிப்புகளை பராமரிக்க இப்பகுதியில் புதிய கூட்டாண்மைகளை நாடுகின்றன.

title: BTCC Exchange Launches Refreshed Trust Center: Alex Hung on Why Security Has to Come First
summary:

content: BTCC Exchange has announced the launch of its refreshed Trust Center. content_ta: Robinhood-ல் வைக்கப்பட்டிருக்கும் கோடிக்கணக்கான மதிப்பிலான கிரிப்டோகரன்சி சொத்துக்கள் நிறுவனத்தின் கருவூலத்திற்கு சொந்தமானவை அல்ல, மாறாக வாடிக்கையாளர்களுக்கே சொந்தமானவை என்று சமீபத்திய சந்தை விளக்கம் தெளிவுபடுத்தியுள்ளது. வாடிக்கையாளர்களின் இந்த டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துக்களை பெருநிறுவன நிதி என்று தவறாகப் புரிந்துகொள்வது சந்தை மதிப்பிட்டில் குழப்பத்தை ஏற்படுத்தலாம், இது முதலீட்டாளர்களின் மனநிலையை பாதிக்கும்.

title: BlackRock’s Nikhil Sharma pitches tokenized money market funds as instant collateral at TOKEN2049
summary:
Tokenized money market funds could revolutionize collateral management, enhancing liquidity and efficiency in financial markets.
The post BlackRock’s Nikhil Sharma pitches tokenized money market funds as instant collateral at TOKEN2049 appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: At the TOKEN2049 event, Nikhil Sharma of BlackRock discussed the potential of tokenized money market funds to serve as instant collateral. This innovation aims to improve liquidity and streamline financial market efficiency. By transforming traditional assets into digital tokens, market participants can achieve faster settlement times and better capital management in trading activities.
content_ta: TOKEN2049 நிகழ்வில், BlackRock நிறுவனத்தைச் சேர்ந்த Nikhil Sharma, டோக்கனைஸ்டு செய்யப்பட்ட மணி மார்க்கெட் ஃபண்டுகளை உடனடி பிணையமாகப் பயன்படுத்துவது குறித்துப் பேசினார். இந்த புதிய முறை நிதிச் சந்தைகளில் பணப்புழக்கத்தையும் செயல்திறனையும் மேம்படுத்த உதவும் என்று எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது.

title: Muneeb Ali pledges Stacks Labs IP transfer to the Stacks Endowment
summary:
Ali's IP transfer pledge to the Stacks Endowment could enhance ecosystem trust, aligning development with community funding priorities.
The post Muneeb Ali pledges Stacks Labs IP transfer to the Stacks Endowment appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Muneeb Ali has pledged to transfer Stacks Labs intellectual property to the Stacks Endowment. This move aims to strengthen the ecosystem by aligning development efforts with community-driven funding priorities, which could potentially enhance overall trust and decentralization within the Stacks network according to recent reports.
content_ta: Stacks Endowment-க்கு Stacks Labs இன்டெலச்சுவல் ப்ராப்பர்ட்டியை transfer செய்வதாக Muneeb Ali உறுதியளித்துள்ளார். இந்த நடவடிக்கை கம்யூனிட்டி ஃபண்டிங் முன்னுரிமைகளுடன் டெவலப்மென்ட் பணிகளை இணைப்பதன் மூலம் Stacks நெட்வொர்க்கில் நம்பிக்கையையும் பரவலாக்கத்தையும் அதிகரிக்கும் என்று எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது.

title: Ethena founder says yield isn’t a commodity because trust isn’t equal
summary:
Ethena's approach highlights the importance of trust and risk management in yield markets, influencing institutional investment strategies.
The post Ethena founder says yield isn’t a commodity because trust isn’t equal appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: The founder of Ethena argued that yield cannot be treated as a simple commodity because varying levels of trust exist across different platforms. This perspective emphasizes that trust and risk management are critical factors in the yield market, which can shape how institutional investors approach their strategies moving forward.
content_ta: yield என்பது ஒரு எளிய commodity அல்ல என்று Ethena நிறுவனத்தின் founder தெரிவித்துள்ளார். பல்வேறு தளங்களில் நம்பிக்கை மாறுபடுவதே இதற்குக் காரணம் என்று அவர் கூறினார். yield சந்தையில் trust மற்றும் risk management மிகவும் முக்கியம் என்பதை இந்தக் கருத்து அடிக்கோடிட்டுக் காட்டுகிறது. இது நிறுவன முதலீட்டாளர்களின் முதலீட்டு உத்திகளைப் பாதிக்கக்கூடும்.

title: AMD CEO Lisa Su heads back to Seoul for talks with Samsung’s chip chief
summary:
AMD's collaboration with Samsung could enhance its competitive edge in AI and server markets, potentially reshaping global chip supply dynamics.
The post AMD CEO Lisa Su heads back to Seoul for talks with Samsung’s chip chief appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: AMD CEO Lisa Su has traveled to Seoul to meet with Samsung's chip division chief. This visit highlights ongoing discussions between the two technology giants. Such a collaboration could significantly strengthen AMD's competitive position within the artificial intelligence and server markets, potentially altering the global semiconductor supply chain dynamics in the near future.
content_ta: AMD CEO Lisa Su, Samsung-யின் chip பிரிவின் தலைவரை சந்திப்பதற்காக Seoul சென்றுள்ளார். இந்த பயணம் இந்த இரண்டு தொழில்நுட்ப நிறுவனங்களுக்கு இடையேயான தொடர்ச்சியான பேச்சுவார்த்தைகளை வெளிச்சம் போட்டுக் காட்டுகிறது. இத்தகைய ஒத்துழைப்பு artificial intelligence மற்றும் server சந்தைகளில் AMD-யின் போட்டித்திறனை கணிசமாக வலுப்படுத்தக்கூடும்.

title: AI agents could pry loose the sleepy deposits US banks depend on
summary:
AI-driven deposit shifts could force banks to raise rates, eroding profit margins and benefiting fintechs offering higher yields.
The post AI agents could pry loose the sleepy deposits US banks depend on appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: AI-driven deposit shifts could force US banks to raise interest rates, potentially eroding profit margins. This trend stands to benefit fintech companies that offer higher yields to customers. Automated AI agents are expected to make it easier for consumers to move their sleepy deposits away from traditional banking institutions in search of better returns.
content_ta: AI-யின் வருகையால் அமெரிக்க வங்கிகளில் உள்ள டெபாசிட்டுகள் மாற வாய்ப்புள்ளது. இதனால் வங்கிகள் வட்டி விகிதங்களை உயர்த்த வேண்டிய கட்டாயம் ஏற்பட்டு, அவற்றின் லாபம் குறையக்கூடும். அதேசமயம், அதிக லாபம் வழங்கும் fintech நிறுவனங்களுக்கு இது சாதகமாக அமையும். பாரம்பரிய வங்கிகளில் உள்ள டெபாசிட்டுகளை வாடிக்கையாளர்கள் எளிதாக மாற்றுவதற்கு AI ஏஜெண்டுகள் உதவுவார்கள்.

title: Coinbase revives Pro branding as Deribit integration reshapes its global exchange
summary:
Coinbase's integration with Deribit could redefine global trading dynamics, enhancing liquidity and competition in the derivatives market.
The post Coinbase revives Pro branding as Deribit integration reshapes its global exchange appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Coinbase is bringing back its Pro branding following a strategic integration with Deribit. This move aims to reshape the company's global exchange operations by enhancing liquidity and increasing competition within the derivatives market. Industry observers note that the collaboration could significantly influence global crypto trading dynamics moving forward.
content_ta: Deribit உடன் இணைந்ததைத் தொடர்ந்து Coinbase தனது Pro பிராண்டிங்கை மீண்டும் கொண்டுவந்துள்ளது. டெரிவேட்டிவ்ஸ் சந்தையில் பணப்புழக்கத்தை மேம்படுத்துவதும் போட்டியைக் அதிகரிப்பதும் இந்த நடவடிக்கையின் நோக்கமாகும். இந்த ஒத்துக்கழைப்பு உலகளாவிய கிரிப்டோ வர்த்தகத்தில் முக்கிய தாக்கத்தை ஏற்படுத்தும் என்று எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது.

title: Global Remittances to Hit $635bn by 2030 as Growth Rate Slows
summary:
Juniper Research forecasts 9.6% market growth from 2026 to 2030, a marked deceleration from the post-COVID surge, squeezing remittance providers on price.
The post Global Remittances to Hit $635bn by 2030 as Growth Rate Slows appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: Global remittances are projected to reach $635 billion by 2030, according to new forecasts from Juniper Research. The market is expected to experience a 9.6% growth rate between 2026 and 2030, marking a significant slowdown compared to the rapid surge seen after the COVID-19 pandemic. This deceleration is anticipated to increase pricing pressure on remittance service providers globally.
content_ta: Juniper Research-ியின் புதிய கணக்கெடுப்பின்படி, 2030-க்குள் உலகளாவிய ரெமிடன்ஸ் (remittances) பரிமாற்றங்கள் $635 பில்லியன் அளவை எட்டும் என எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது. COVID-19 தொற்றுநோய்க்குப் பிந்தைய காலத்தில் ஏற்பட்ட விரைவான வளர்ச்சியுடன் ஒப்பிடும்போது மந்தநிலையைக் குறிக்கும் வகையில், 2026 முதல் 2030 வரை சந்தை 9.6% வளர்ச்சியை மட்டுமே காணும் என்று கணிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: CompassPoint Warns Agentic AI in Finance Needs Boardroom Governance
summary:
UAE fractional CFO firm CompassPoint says agentic AI demands accountability frameworks before deployment, not after, especially for SMEs.
The post CompassPoint Warns Agentic AI in Finance Needs Boardroom Governance appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: UAE fractional CFO firm CompassPoint has warned that the growing use of agentic AI in financial services requires strict boardroom governance. The company emphasizes that accountability frameworks must be established before deployment, particularly for small and medium-sized enterprises, to ensure proper oversight and manage risks effectively.
content_ta: நிதிச் சேவைகளில் Agentic AI பயன்பாடு அதிகரித்து வரும் நிலையில், அதற்கு கடுமையான நிர்வாகக் கட்டமைப்பு அவசியம் என்று UAE-ஐச் சேர்ந்த fractional CFO நிறுவனமான CompassPoint எச்சரித்துள்ளது. சிறிய மற்றும் நடுத்தர நிறுவனங்களுக்கு இந்த தொழில்நுட்பத்தை அமல்படுத்துவதற்கு முன்பாகவே பொறுப்புக்கூறும் கட்டமைப்புகள் உருவாக்கப்பட வேண்டும் என்று அந்நிறுவனம் வலியுறுத்துகிறது.

title: Brazil’s Fintech Stocks Rally as Flávio Bolsonaro’s First-Round Lead Signals a Potential Rightward Shift
summary: Brazilian Fintech focused stocks jumped sharply in US trading on Monday after the first round of the country’s presidential election left Senator Flávio Bolsonaro narrowly ahead of incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, raising the odds of a rightward policy turn before a runoff set... Read More
content: Brazilian fintech-focused stocks rallied sharply in U.S. trading following the first round of the country's presidential election. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro secured a narrow lead over incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, signaling a potential rightward shift in national policy ahead of the upcoming runoff election.
content_ta: பிரேசிலின் ஃபின்டெக் பங்குகள் அந்நாட்டின் ஜனாதிபதித் தேர்தலின் முதல் சுற்று முடிவுகளைத் தொடர்ந்து அமெரிக்க வர்த்தகத்தில் கடுமையாக உயர்ந்தன. செனட்டர் Flávio Bolsonaro தற்போதைய ஜனாதிபதி Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva-வை விட சிறிய முன்னிலை பெற்றுள்ளதால், வரவிருக்கும் இரண்டாவது சுற்றுத் தேர்தலில் வலதுசாரி கொள்கை மாற்றம் ஏற்படக்கூடும் என்ற எதிர்பார்ப்பு எழுந்துள்ளது.

title: Robinhood adds bitcoin worth $25 million to its balance sheet
summary: Robinhood has added bitcoin worth $25 million to its balance sheet, senior vice president and general manager of crypto and international, told the Starting Block Wednesday.
content: Robinhood has added $25 million worth of bitcoin to its balance sheet. The move was confirmed by a senior vice president and general manager of crypto and international at the company during an event on Wednesday, highlighting the firm's ongoing involvement with digital assets.
content_ta: Robinhood நிறுவனம் தனது இருப்புநிலைக் குறிப்பில் 25 மில்லியன் டாலர் மதிப்புள்ள bitcoin-ஐச் சேர்த்துள்ளது. புதன்கிழமை நடைபெற்ற ஒரு நிகழ்ச்சியில் இந்நிறுவனத்தின் கிரிப்டோ மற்றும் சர்வதேச பிரிவு மூத்த துணைத் தலைவர் மற்றும் பொது மேலாளர் இதனை உறுதிப்படுத்தினார்.

title: Down but not out. Bitcoin's stair-step bullish trajectory is still intact
summary: Bitcoin dipped to around $84,200 on Wednesday but stayed inside its recent range, keeping the broader bullish stair-step trajectory intact.
content: Bitcoin recently dipped to around $84,200 on Wednesday, experiencing a minor downward movement. However, market analysts note that the cryptocurrency has successfully remained within its recent trading range. This price action indicates that the broader bullish stair-step trajectory for Bitcoin is still entirely intact, reassuring investors amid ongoing market fluctuations.
content_ta: Bitcoin புதன்கிழமை அன்று சுமார் $84,200 வரை சரிந்து, ஒரு சிறிய விலிறக்கத்தைச் சந்தித்தது. இருப்பினும், இந்த cryptocurrency அதன் சமீபவிலை வரம்பிற்குள்ளேயே உறுதியாக நிலைபெற்றுள்ளதாக சந்தை ஆய்வாளர்கள் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர். இந்த விலை நிலவரம், Bitcoin-ன் ஒட்டுமொத்த காளைச் சந்தை (bullish) போக்கு இன்னும் முழுமையாக மாறாமல் அப்படியே தொடர்வதை உறுதிப்படுத்துகிறது.

title: BitMine sets 5% Ether supply ‘hard cap’ as accumulation target nears
summary: Tom Lee said BitMine will not accumulate Ether past 5% of the supply, turning the company’s target into a ceiling.
content: BitMine has established a hard cap of 5% on its Ether supply accumulation target, according to Tom Lee. The company announced that it will not acquire Ether beyond this percentage, effectively turning its previous accumulation goal into a firm ceiling for future holdings.
content_ta: Tom Lee-ன் கூற்றுப்படி, BitMine நிறுவனம் தனது Ether சேமிப்பு இலக்கில் 5% என்ற கடுமையான உச்சவரம்பை (hard cap) நிர்ணயித்துள்ளது. இந்த சதவீதத்திற்கு மேல் Ether-ஐ சேகரிக்கப் போவதில்லை என்றும், நிறுவனத்தின் முந்தைய இலக்கு இனி ஒரு உறுதியான உச்சவரம்பாக மாற்றப்படும் என்றும் நிறுவனம் அறிவித்துள்ளது.

title: Russia clears first crypto exchanges, custodians under new law
summary: Russia registered its first crypto exchanges and custodians, including its largest bank, Sberbank, which plans to launch crypto products on Dec. 1.
content: Russia has officially cleared its first cryptocurrency exchanges and custodians under a newly implemented law. Among the newly registered institutions is Sberbank, the country's largest bank, which has announced plans to introduce digital asset and crypto products to the market starting December 1.
content_ta: புதிய சட்டத்தின் கீழ் ரஷ்யா தனது முதல் கிரிப்டோகரன்சி எக்ஸ்சேஞ்சுகள் மற்றும் கஸ்டடியன்களை அதிகாரப்பூர்வமாக அங்கீகரித்துள்ளது. புதிதாக பதிவு செய்யப்பட்ட நிறுவனங்களில் நாட்டின் மிகப்பெரிய வங்கியான Sberbank-ம் அடங்கும். இந்த வங்கி டிசம்பர் 1 முதல் சந்தையில் கிரிப்டோ தயாரிப்புகளை அறிமுகப்படுத்த திட்டமிட்டுள்ளது.

title: DOJ invokes Bitcoin Fog ruling in potential blow to Roman Storm acquittal bid
summary: Prosecutors say a recent Bitcoin Fog appeals court ruling supports their argument that Tornado Cash activity in Manhattan was enough to establish venue for parts of Roman Storm’s case in New York.
content: Federal prosecutors are citing a recent Bitcoin Fog appeals court ruling to counter Roman Storm's acquittal bid. The government argues that this precedent establishes proper venue in New York for parts of the Tornado Cash case, asserting that the platform's activity in Manhattan is sufficient for the prosecution to proceed there.
content_ta: Roman Storm-ன் விடுவிப்பு கோரிக்கையை எதிர்க்கும் வகையில், சமீபத்திய Bitcoin Fog மேல்முறையீட்டு நீதிமன்றத் தீர்ப்பை பெடரல் வழக்கறிஞர்கள் மேற்கோள் காட்டியுள்ளனர். Manhattan பகுதியில் உள்ள Tornado Cash நடவடிக்கைகள் நியூயார்க்கில் வழக்குத் தொடர போதுமானது என்று அரசாங்கம் வாதிடுகிறது.

title: ‘Every single exchange’ will have to adopt public blockchain infrastructure to compete, Hyperliquid Policy Center CEO says

content: According to the Hyperliquid Policy Center CEO, every single financial exchange will eventually need to adopt public blockchain infrastructure to remain competitive. He noted that onchain markets must enter the regulatory perimeter in the United States, a transition he anticipates will take place in the near future.
content_ta: Hyperliquid Policy Center-ன் CEO-வின் கூற்றுப்படி, சந்தையில் போட்டியிட அனைத்து பரிமாற்றங்களும் (exchanges) பொதுவான பிளாக்செயின் (blockchain) உள்கட்டமைப்பை ஏற்க வேண்டியிருக்கும். அமெரிக்காவின் ஒழுங்குமுறை எல்லைக்குள் ஆன்செயின் (onchain) சந்தைகள் நுழைய வேண்டும் என்றும், இந்த மாற்றம் விரைவில் நிகழும் என்றும் அவர் குறிப்பிட்டுள்ளார்.

content: A significant withdrawal of 24,000 BTC from crypto exchanges suggests that a supply crunch for Bitcoin may be intensifying. title: AMD plans to invest tens of billions in its global supply chain as AI demand outruns output
summary:
AMD's massive investment in its supply chain highlights the critical need for robust infrastructure to meet surging AI-driven demand.
The post AMD plans to invest tens of billions in its global supply chain as AI demand outruns output appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: AMD plans to invest tens of billions of dollars into its global supply chain. This strategic move comes as soaring global demand for artificial intelligence outruns current production output, highlighting the critical need for expanded infrastructure in the tech industry.
content_ta: ஏஐ (AI) தொழில்நுட்பத்திற்கான தேவை வெகுவாக அதிகரித்து வரும் நிலையில், தனது குளோபல் சப்ளை செயினில் பல்லாயிரக்கணக்கான கோடி டூலர்களை முதலீடு செய்ய AMD திட்டமிட்டுள்ளது. தொழில்நுட்பத் துறையில் உள்கட்டமைப்பை மேம்படுத்துவதன் அவசியத்தை இந்த பெரிய முதலீடு எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

title: Goldman Sachs forecasts 27% jump in S&P 500 profits as AI spending carries the load
summary:
AI-driven profit growth in the S&P 500 highlights the transformative economic impact of technology investments, despite potential future risks.
The post Goldman Sachs forecasts 27% jump in S&P 500 profits as AI spending carries the load appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Goldman Sachs has projected a significant 27 percent increase in S&P 500 profits, driven largely by ongoing artificial intelligence spending. According to financial reports, this technology-led growth demonstrates the powerful economic influence of current tech investments on the broader market, even as analysts continue to monitor potential future risks.
content_ta: Goldman Sachs நிறுவனம் S&P 500 லாபத்தில் 27 சதவீத உயர்வு இருக்கும் என்று கணித்துள்ளது. AI துறை சார்ந்த செலவினங்களே இந்த வளர்ச்சிக்கு முக்கிய காரணமாகக் கூறப்படுகிறது. தொழில்நுட்ப முதலீடுகள் பொருளாதாரத்தில் பெரும் தாக்கத்தை ஏற்படுத்துவதை இந்த வளர்ச்சி காட்டுகிறது.

title: AMD CEO Lisa Su calls Samsung and SK Hynix important for long-term supply chain
summary:
AMD's strategic partnerships with Samsung and SK Hynix highlight the critical need for robust supply chains in the rapidly evolving AI market.
The post AMD CEO Lisa Su calls Samsung and SK Hynix important for long-term supply chain appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: AMD CEO Lisa Su has emphasized the vital role that Samsung and SK Hynix play in ensuring a stable long-term supply chain. Speaking about industry partnerships, the comments highlight how critical robust semiconductor supply chains are for supporting the rapidly growing artificial intelligence market and meeting future hardware demands across the technology sector.
content_ta: AMD CEO Lisa Su, தனது நீண்ட கால சப்ளை செயினுக்கு Samsung மற்றும் SK Hynix ஆகியவை எவ்வளவு முக்கியம் என்பதை வலியுறுத்தியுள்ளார். தொழிற்துறை கூட்டாண்மைகள் குறித்து பேசிய அவர், வேகமாக வளர்ந்து வரும் AI சந்தையின் தேவைகளை பூர்த்தி செய்யவும், எதிர்கால வன்பொருள் தேவைகளை சமாளிக்கவும் வலுவான செமிக்கண்டக்டர் சப்ளை செயின்கள் எவ்வளவுக்கு எவ்வளவு அவசியமானவை என்பதை சுட்டிக்காட்டியுள்ளார்.

title: Eric Trump frames tokenization as democratizing finance ahead of Token2049 keynote
summary:
Tokenization could democratize asset investment, but potential conflicts of interest may challenge its portrayal as purely philanthropic.
The post Eric Trump frames tokenization as democratizing finance ahead of Token2049 keynote appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Ahead of the Token2049 conference keynote, Eric Trump discussed tokenization as a tool for democratizing finance. While this technology aims to make asset investment more accessible, observers note that potential conflicts of interest could complicate its image as a purely philanthropic effort.
content_ta: Token2049 மாநாட்டின் முக்கிய உரைக்கு முன்னதாக, Eric Trump டோக்கனைசேஷனை நிதித்துறையை மக்களாக்கும் ஒரு கருவியாக விவரித்தார். இந்த தொழில்நுட்பம் சொத்து முதலீட்டை எளிதாக்க முயன்றாலும், சாத்தியமான நல மோதல்கள் இதன் நோக்கத்தை கேள்விக்குள்ளாக்கலாம் என்று பார்வையாளர்கள் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர்.

title: Hyperliquid to add options to platform, enhancing derivatives offerings
summary:

content: Hyperliquid is planning to add options to its platform, a move designed to enhance its current derivatives offerings. content_ta: Hyperliquid தனது தளத்தில் ஆப்ஷன்ஸ் வர்த்தகத்தை சேர்க்க திட்டமிட்டுள்ளது. இதன் மூலம் அதன் டெரிவேட்டிவ்ஸ் சேவைகள் மேலும் மேம்படுத்தப்படும். இந்த மூலோபாய விரிவாக்கம் சந்தையில் அதன் நிலையை பலப்படுத்தும் என்றும், பயனர் ஈடு்ப்பாட்டை அதிகரிக்கும் என்றும் எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது.

title: Meritz Securities Partners With Ripple to Explore Digital Asset Services in South Korea
summary:
The post Meritz Securities Partners With Ripple to Explore Digital Asset Services in South Korea appeared first on Coinpedia Fintech News
Meritz Securities has partnered with Ripple to study digital asset custody and tokenization for South Korea’s capital markets. The deal could help Meritz prepare for regulated digital asset products as Korea develops its legal framework. The firms will initially assess Ripple’s infrastructure within existing securities rules and regulations. Meritz is also reviewing digital asset ETFs, …
content: Meritz Securities has partnered with Ripple to explore digital asset services in South Korea. The collaboration focuses on studying digital asset custody and tokenization for capital markets as the country develops its legal framework. Both firms will initially assess Ripple's infrastructure under current securities regulations, while Meritz also reviews potential digital asset exchange-traded products.
content_ta: South Korea-வில் டிஜிட்டல் அசெட் சேவைகளை ஆராய்வதற்காக Meritz Securities நிறுவனம் Ripple உடன் கூட்டு சேர்ந்துள்ளது. நாட்டின் சட்டக் கட்டமைப்பு வளர்ச்சியடைந்து வரும் நிலையில், மூலதன சந்தைகளுக்கான டிஜிட்டல் அசெட் கஸ்டடி மற்றும் டோக்கனைசேஷன் ஆகியவற்றை ஆய்வு செய்வதில் இந்த ஒத்துழைப்பு கவனம் செலுத்துகிறது. தற்போதைய செக்யூரிட்டிகள் ஒழுங்குமுறைகளின் கீழ் Ripple இன் உள்கட்டமைப்பை இரு நிறுவனங்களும் ஆரம்பத்தில் மதிப்பீடு செய்யும்.

title: North Carolina Man Sentenced to 18 Months for Super Intelligence-Assisted Music Streaming Fraud
summary:
Federal prosecutors have secured an 18-month prison sentence against a North Carolina resident who used super intelligence to generate fake songs and automate billions of streams on major platforms. Michael Smith, 54, of Cornelius, North Carolina, was also ordered to serve two years of supervised release and forfeit $8,091,843.64 after pleading guilty in March, says […]
The post North Carolina Man Sentenced to 18 Months for Super Intelligence-Assisted Music Streaming Fraud appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: A North Carolina man has been sentenced to 18 months in prison for using technology to generate fake songs and automate billions of streams on major music platforms. Michael Smith, 54, was also ordered to serve supervised release and forfeit over eight million dollars after pleading guilty to fraud charges.
content_ta: Music streaming platforms-ல் போலியான பாடல்களை உருவாக்க மற்றும் பில்லியன்க கணக்கில் தானியங்கி முறையில் ஸ்ட்ரீம்களை நடத்த தொழில்நுட்பத்தைப் பயன்படுத்திய North Carolina-வைச் சேர்ந்த நபருக்கு 18 மாதங்கள் சிறைத்தண்டனை விதிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. Michael Smith (54) மீது சுமத்தப்பட்ட குற்றச்சாட்டுகள் நிரூபிக்கப்பட்டதை அடுத்து, அவர் சிறைத் தண்டனை மற்றும் பல மில்லியன் டாலர்களை இழப்பீடு செய்ய உத்தரவிடப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Bitcoin slips below $84,000 ahead of FOMC minutes
summary:
Key takeaways Bitcoin briefly fell below $84,000 during Wednesday’s Asian session. Rising oil prices added inflation concerns ahead of the FOMC minutes, keeping interest-rate expectations in focus. BTC’s immediate support lies around 80,000–82,000, while a sustained break above $87,000 could put $100,000 in focus. Bitcoin weakened Wednesday as investors awaited the Federal Reserve’s meeting minutes […]
The post Bitcoin slips below $84,000 ahead of FOMC minutes appeared first on CoinJournal.
content: Bitcoin dropped below $84,000 during the Asian session as investors awaited the Federal Reserve’s upcoming FOMC minutes. Heightened inflation concerns, driven by rising oil prices, have kept global interest-rate expectations in focus. Analysts note that Bitcoin's immediate support rests near the $80,000 to $82,000 range, while a move past $87,000 could target the psychological $100,000 mark.
content_ta: FOMC நிமிட வெளியீட்டை முதலீட்டாளர்கள் எதிர்பார்த்துக் காத்திருக்கும் வேளையில், ஆசிய வர்த்தக அமர்வில் Bitcoin விலையானது $84,000-க்கும் கீழே சரிந்தது. எண்ணெய் விலை உயர்வால் பணவீக்கம் குறித்த கவலைகள் அதிகரித்துள்ளதால், வட்டி விகித எதிர்பார்ப்புகள் முக்கியத்துவம் பெற்றுள்ளன. Bitcoin-க்கான தற்காலிக ஆதரவு நிலை $80,000 முதல் $82,000 வரை உள்ளதாக ஆய்வாளர்கள் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர்.

title: SIBOS Miami 2026: Will Moroney – Chief Revenue Officer – Temenos

title: CBI’s Fratini Passi on Stopping Fraud Before the Money Moves
summary:
CBI managing director Liliana Fratini Passi on how Verification of Payee and Request to Pay are helping stop payment fraud before money leaves the account.
The post CBI’s Fratini Passi on Stopping Fraud Before the Money Moves appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: CBI managing director Liliana Fratini Passi recently discussed strategies for preventing payment fraud before transactions are completed. She highlighted how tools like Verification of Payee and Request to Pay play a crucial role in stopping fraudulent activities proactively, ensuring that money remains secure before leaving the account.
content_ta: பணம் பரிமாற்றம் செய்யப்படுவதற்கு முன்பே மோசடிகளைத் தடுப்பதற்கான உத்திகள் குறித்து CBI இன் நிர்வாக இயக்குநர் Liliana Fratini Passi விவாதித்துள்ளார். Verification of Payee மற்றும் Request to Pay போன்ற கருவிகள் மோசடி நடவடிக்கைகளை முன்கூட்டியே தடுத்து, கணக்கில் இருந்து பணம் வெளியேறுவதை பாதுகாப்பாக வைத்திருக்க எவ்வாறு உதவுகின்றன என்பதை அவர் விளக்கினார்.

title: PensionBee Flags Three Life Events that Erode Retirement Savings
summary:
A PPI report commissioned by the ABI finds divorce, caring duties and the Bank of Mum and Dad are quietly hollowing out pension adequacy.
The post PensionBee Flags Three Life Events that Erode Retirement Savings appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: A recent PPI report commissioned by the ABI reveals that divorce, caring responsibilities, and financial support for family members significantly erode retirement savings. PensionBee highlighted these three major life events, warning that they quietly undermine pension adequacy for many individuals over time.
content_ta: ABI-ன் அனுசரணையோடு தயாரிக்கப்பட்ட புதிய PPI அறிக்கை, விவாகரத்து, பராமரிப்புப் பொறுப்புகள் மற்றும் குடும்பத்தினருக்கு வழங்கப்படும் நிதி உதவி ஆகியவை ஓய்வூதிய சேமிப்பைப் பெரிதும் பாதிக்கின்றன என்பதை வெளிப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த மூன்று முக்கியமான வாழ்க்கை நிகழ்வுகள் ஓய்வூதியப் பாதுகாப்பை மென்மையாகக் குறைக்கின்றன என்று PensionBee எச்சரித்துள்ளது.

title: Sibos 2026: the week Miami made trust the price of speed
summary:
The industry spent Miami agreeing on something it has been circling for three years. The technology for tokenised money and for AI agents is no longer the argument. The argument is who carries the trust when it goes wrong.
The post Sibos 2026: the week Miami made trust the price of speed appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: At Sibos 2026 in Miami, industry leaders agreed that tokenised money and AI agents are no longer the main debate. Instead, the central challenge is determining accountability and trust when automated financial systems fail. Experts emphasized that speed in modern transactions must be matched by clear responsibility for potential errors.
content_ta: Miami நகரில் நடைபெற்ற Sibos 2026 மாநாட்டில், tokenised money மற்றும் AI agents குறித்த தொழில்நுட்ப விவாதங்கள் கடந்துவிட்டதாக தலைவர்கள் ஒப்புக்கொண்டனர். மாறாக, தானியங்கி நிதி அமைப்புகளில் பிழைகள் ஏற்படும்போது யார் பொறுப்பேற்பது என்ற நம்பிக்கையும் பொறுப்புணர்வும் தற்போது முக்கிய விவாதப் பொருளாக மாறியுள்ளன.

title: Spiko Raises $90M Series B Led by NEA to Make Yield Universal
summary:
Spiko, the tokenized cash fund leader, today announced a $90 million Series B led by New Enterprise Associates (NEA), with participation from investors including Index Ventures, Bpifrance, Speedinvest, Flourish Ventures, Shapers, White Star Capital, Blockwall, Frst, EQNX, Mirana Ventures, and Wintermute Ventures. Prominent angels also joined, including Axel Weber, former president of the Bundesbank, and the founders of Qonto. The round brings Spiko’s total funding to $120 million.
Europe and the United States hold around $50 trillion in cash and deposits, and most of it earns little or nothing. With central bank rates ranging from 2.5% in the euro area to close to 4% in the United States, every percentage point of yield on that sum is worth $500 billion a year. The businesses and people who own the money see almost none of it.
Banks and large institutions earn that yield every day, through the wholesale financial system. Everyone else, from entrepreneurs and small businesses to nonprofits and smaller financial institutions, holds money that earns nothing by default. Access to yield is a class system. Spiko was founded to end it.
“Every person and every organization holds cash, yet whether it earns anything still depends on who you are and how much you have,” said Paul-Adrien Hyppolite, co-founder and CEO of Spiko. “Yield should be universal. Our ambition is to make all cash earn by default, around the clock.”
Making cash earn for everyone
Money market funds have existed for decades and offer an efficient way to earn returns on cash. But outside the United States, they have never gone mainstream.
Spiko bridges that gap. It designs its own range of regulated cash funds, from intraday liquidity to term products. Businesses access them through a desktop and mobile app, and any company or financial platform can embed them into its own product via an API. Clients include startups and scale-ups, research institutes, public institutions, VC funds, and medical practices, with funds available in euros, dollars, sterling, and Swiss francs.
Keeping it earning 24/7
Making yield accessible is only part of the problem. Money market funds were designed around markets, payment, and accounting systems that operate during business hours, not for a world where money moves continuously through software, let alone one shaped by AI agents.
A company needs cash available for a payment this afternoon. A fintech needs to maintain liquidity for its users overnight and on weekends. A stablecoin issuer holds billions in reserves around the clock. With no suitable product available, that cash often sits idle. Spiko builds its funds for that world, with instant withdrawals today and, soon, yield that accrues continuously, every hour of every day.
“We looked at dozens of companies solving pieces of this problem. We believe Spiko is the only one that’s solved the regulatory piece and the product piece at the same time,” said Philip Chopin, Managing Director, Head of Europe, at NEA. “Paul-Adrien and Antoine are building the default home for cash. Money market funds are where trust is earned, and the same model extends naturally to new markets and new products.”
Putting treasury on autopilot
Spiko issues its funds onchain and now ranks ahead of BlackRock and Franklin Templeton as the largest issuer of tokenized cash funds1. Onchain funds run on the same rails as stablecoins and smart contracts, which makes cash programmable.
Programmable cash lets a company automate its entire treasury. A finance team sets its rules once on Spiko: keep enough in the operating account for payroll and supplier payments, sweep everything above that into a fund it can draw on at any time, and place cash it won’t need for a quarter into a fixed-term fund at a higher rate. Spiko executes that program day and night, and the company’s treasury management system (TMS), or an AI agent acting on its behalf, can adjust it through the API.
By the numbers
$2.7 billion in assets under management, across regulated cash funds in four currencies and multiple public blockchains
More than fivefold growth in AUM over the past 12 months
10,000+ businesses and individuals in more than 25 jurisdictions already using Spiko
$120 million raised to date, including this $90 million Series B
Spiko operates from hubs in London and Paris and is building local teams across Europe, including in Germany, Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and the Nordics. The new funding will go into three areas: launching new funds, opening new markets, and growing the team.

title: One in 10 New Merchants Encounters Fraud Within First 90 Days, Fraudio Data Discovers
summary:
One in 10 newly observed merchants experiences fraud within its first 90 days of trading, according to new analysis from AI-powered fraud detection company Fraudio, highlighting how quickly fraud can emerge before businesses have had time to establish a meaningful history of normal customer behaviour.
Fraudio analysed a global dataset consisting of a sample of more than 127.5 million transactions between January 2025 and April 2026. Among 3,923 merchants whose first recorded transaction took place during 2025, and which had not appeared in the data previously, 10.5% experienced at least one fraud-labelled transaction within their first 90 days.
For those merchants affected by fraud during their first 90 days, the median time from their first transaction to their first fraud was just 33 days. A quarter encountered fraud within nine days, while three quarters did so within 61 days.
Almost one in five of those merchants experienced their first fraud during their first week, while 47% experienced it within the first 30 days. The concentration was particularly pronounced at the beginning of the period, when adjusted for the different lengths of each time band, first frauds occurred at almost three times the daily rate during the first week compared with days 31 to 90.
The findings point to a fundamental challenge for fraud prevention that fraud can begin before a merchant has accumulated enough transaction history to establish reliable patterns of what legitimate activity looks like.
Fraudio's analysis also found that examining an individual payment in isolation provides relatively little indication of whether it will turn out to be fraudulent. Based only on the transaction's amount, currency and channel compared with that merchant's typical activity, 82% of fraudulent transactions appeared unremarkable. The equivalent figure for legitimate transactions was 84%, suggesting that these transaction-level attributes alone offer little ability to separate fraud from genuine payments.
By contrast, historical connections between transactions can be considerably more informative. Across the wider dataset, 30% of fraudulent transactions involved a card that had already been connected to an earlier fraud, compared with just 0.075% of legitimate transactions. Fraudio cautions that this is a retrospective measure because fraud labels can be confirmed by chargebacks after the original transaction, rather than a measure of what could necessarily have been known in real time.
João Moura, CEO and Co-Founder of Fraudio, commented,"Fraudsters don't wait for a business to build six months of transaction history before they begin attacking it. Our data shows that the opposite can happen as fraud can emerge within days, at exactly the point when a merchant has the least historical information available to understand what normal behaviour looks like.
"The other challenge is that fraudulent payments frequently don't look unusual when viewed on their own. The amount may be normal, the currency may be normal and the payment channel may be normal. What increasingly matters is the context around that transaction - what has happened before, how different entities are connected and whether apparently ordinary behaviour forms part of a wider pattern.
"Payment companies should not have to learn what fraud looks like by experiencing losses first. Fraud prevention needs to start with context from day one."
Fraudio's analysis also found that the fraud rate per transaction was 2.9 times higher during merchants' first 90 days than among payment programmes more than a year old, showing that early-stage merchants face a disproportionately higher fraud risk rather than simply accumulating more incidents over time.
The first 90 days in numbers:
10.5% of newly observed merchants experienced fraud within 90 days.
33 days was the median time to first fraud among those affected.
20% of early-hit merchants encountered their first fraud during their first week.
47% encountered it within their first 30 days.
82% of fraudulent transactions looked unremarkable when judged only by amount, currency and payment channel.
The merchant cohort comprised 3,923 businesses first observed during 2025. Fraudio's analysis uses fraud confirmed in its transaction data.
For more information about the data, please visit: https://go.fraudio.com/fraudio-data-led-insights

title: Plaid Releases New AI Models to Improve Decisions Across Credit, Fraud and Payments
summary:
Plaid, the network that powers digital finance, today unveiled new AI models that help financial firms make better lending decisions, catch more fraud, and reduce payment risk, as part of its annual Fall Product Release.
Plaid launched Instant Link, which lets consumers share financial insights with lenders in seconds, alongside an expanded LendScore suite of credit risk models, including LendScore 2 and LendScore Arc, its first transformer-based credit risk score. Plaid also introduced a new AI foundation model for fraud detection, now powering Plaid Protect, and extended its sequential foundation model to payment risk through Signal and Guaranteed Payments.
The foundation models benefit from the breadth of Plaid’s network, which spans thousands of financial institutions and millions of consumers, providing exposure to a wide variety of financial formats, income levels, and economic behaviors needed to learn patterns that generalize across real financial lives.
"Our credit, fraud, and payments models are unique because they bring deep financial context to every problem they're solving," said Will Robinson, CTO at Plaid. "They build on foundation models that already understand how financial behavior unfolds over time, across the Plaid Network, and that means better decisions, and better outcomes, for our customers and the millions of people who depend on those services to manage their own financial lives."
Smarter lending with faster data sharing and more predictive models
Millions of US adults fall outside of the traditional credit lens, making them difficult to evaluate with traditional credit scores alone. Cash flow data shows how people earn, spend, and pay their bills, giving lenders a fuller picture of their ability to repay.
Plaid is introducing three advances in cash flow underwriting:
Faster insights sharing with Instant Link: Added steps during a credit application can result in borrower drop off. With Instant Link, borrowers who connect their financial accounts to Plaid Consumer Reporting Agency can consent to share their cash flow insights for future credit applications, creating a faster experience. Lenders have access to those insights in under two seconds.
Sharper credit decisions with LendScore 2 (Ls2): Plaid’s new core model is 42% stronger at predicting a borrower’s ability to repay a loan compared to traditional credit data alone. New specialized models extend those gains for specific industries: Ls2 Auto lowered delinquency by 26% among deep-subprime applicants at the same approval rate. Ls2 Home Lending approved 6.3% more borrowers at the same level of risk, bringing cash flow underwriting into two markets that have historically relied almost entirely on traditional credit data. The LendScore family also includes a model purpose-built for short-term lending.
More advanced risk modeling with LendScore Arc: Powered by Plaid’s sequential foundation model, Arc is a transformer-based credit risk model that learns from the order and timing of a borrower’s transactions, making it Plaid’s best-performing credit model yet, for lenders ready to leverage transformer-based credit modeling. In early testing, we saw that Arc delivers significant predictive lift over our core model, including 20% lift on deep subprime and 24% lift on superprime borrowers.
“Cash flow data tells a more complete story about a borrower. The challenge has been turning that story into insights that lenders can access and act on with speed and confidence,” said Michelle Young, Credit Product Lead at Plaid. “The next generation of LendScore and specialized models close that gap at scale, and with Arc, we’re giving lenders new tools to expand access to more affordable credit.”
Extending the same intelligence to fraud and payments
The Fall Product Release brings these advances beyond credit, helping businesses detect fraud and make more confident payment decisions. Fraud often emerges from a sequence of seemingly routine actions. A new AI foundation model purpose-built for fraud now enhances Plaid's fraud detection solution, Protect. Trained on patterns and hundreds of millions of data points from the Plaid Network, it analyzes the full sequence of events rather than a snapshot to strengthen the Trust Index, Protect's existing scoring framework. In internal evaluations, it delivered up to 40% relative improvement over previous baselines.
Plaid’s sequential foundation model also powers Signal, Plaid's ACH payment risk model, which reads an account's transaction history in sequence to better predict payment risk. In testing, the sequential foundation model helped Signal prevent 26% more ACH returns without increasing false flags. Guaranteed Payments uses that sharper risk analysis to give businesses more flexible approval options, including delayed release and partial guarantees, rather than a single approve-or-decline decision.

content: Plaid has announced new artificial intelligence models designed to improve decision-making across credit, fraud detection, and payments during its annual Fall Product Release. These tools leverage financial context from the Plaid network to help institutions make safer and more accurate financial decisions.

title: TransUnion UK Strengthens Executive Leadership Team
summary:
TransUnion UK & Europe has announced several senior appointments as the business continues driving innovation across the region. These appointments follow the promotion of a number of existing executive committee members to international roles and reflect the advancement of strong internal talent as part of succession planning.
Steve Wishart has been promoted to chief revenue officer for TransUnion’s UK business, effective 1 October 2026. He brings more than 12 years of experience at TransUnion in the UK, most recently serving as director of sales for financial services. In his new role, Steve will lead the UK sales and sales specialist teams. His deep knowledge of TransUnion, its evolving market offering and strong relationships position him well to build on the strong foundations already in place. Steve brings broad experience from across fraud prevention roles and the wider financial services sector, having previously held leadership roles at Morgan Stanley and MBNA.
Mahesh Bharadhwaj joined as chief data and analytics officer for the UK & Europe on 21 September 2026. He brings more than 20 years of experience in data, analytics, credit risk, pricing and commercial strategy, having held senior leadership roles across FinTech and financial services, including Jaja Finance, Funding Circle, Barclaycard, Oliver Wyman, and Capital One. Most recently, Mahesh served as chief analytics officer at Jaja Finance, where he led analytics, credit strategy, valuations modelling and data science functions. His appointment follows the promotion of Praneeth Meka to the role of chief data and analytics officer for TransUnion’s International business.
Ashley Hart joined on 7 September 2026 as chief operating officer for the UK & Europe, following the promotion of Laura Barley to vice president, head of customer experience transformation in TransUnion’s International operations. Ashley is an accomplished operations, risk, and transformation executive, with senior leadership experience across Monzo Bank, TSB Bank, the Financial Ombudsman Service and most recently at Flutter Entertainment. He brings a strong track record of commercial leadership, alongside deep expertise in regulated operations, financial crime, technology-enabled transformation and customer protection.
Catherine Diamond joined as chief human resources officer UK & Europe on 14 September 2026. An accomplished people and culture leader, Catherine brings more than 20 years of experience across banking, insurance and FinTech, including senior roles at Tandem Bank, Vanquis Banking Group, TSB and Lloyds Banking Group. She has built a strong reputation for leading HR strategy and rollout, executive succession and talent strategy, while partnering closely with boards, CEOs and regulators to deliver business growth and strong governance. Catherine’s appointment follows predecessor Kaushik Gopalan’s decision to return to India, from where he continues to consult for TransUnion.
“As TransUnion continues to drive growth and transformation across its UK and Europe region, I’m delighted to welcome such an exceptional group of talented executives to our leadership team. These appointments, alongside several other recent additions, represent the next generation of leadership that will guide us with purpose as we advance our mission of Information for Good. Their expertise will help accelerate the growth of our credit, fraud and marketing propositions, while sharpening our focus on delivering even greater value to clients,” said Madhu Kejriwal, chief executive officer of TransUnion UK and Europe.
“It’s also a point of pride that our regional talent is recognised and sought after internationally, and we continue to grow and promote talent in the region following several prestigious promotions from our business,” he added.

title: Payouts.com Expands Its Fraud Prevention Suite with Payout Fraud Detection, Stopping Multi-Identity Abuse Before Funds Are Released
summary:
Payouts.com, the AI-native financial operations OS, today announced Payout Fraud Detection, the latest addition to its fraud prevention and compliance suite. The capability identifies when one person poses as several recipients to collect rewards, referral bonuses or rebates, and stops the payment before any money leaves the account.
Referral programs, cashback platforms and rebate offers are frequent targets for "multi-accounting," where one individual creates several identities to claim rewards meant for many different people. At hundreds or thousands of payouts a day, these patterns are nearly impossible to spot manually. Payout Fraud Detection adds a dedicated layer of protection to Payouts.com's existing KYC, compliance, and recipient-identity controls. It screens every payout-link redemption in real time.
The moment a recipient opens a payout link, the system checks for signs of funneling: multiple payouts going to the same account or wallet (such as PayPal and Venmo), claimed from the same device, or coming through the same network. If it finds a match, it stops the payout at the exact same point.
"Multi-identity abuse is one of the most persistent challenges for any business that rewards its users," said Barak Hirchson, Co-founder and Chief AI Officer at Payouts.com. "Payout Fraud Detection gives our customers precise, configurable control over that risk, so they can keep rewarding real customers while stopping fraudsters before a single dollar goes out."
"Payout Fraud Detection's same-device and duplicate-destination detection, along with flexible rules for alerting, holding or rejecting withdrawals, checked critical boxes for us as a design partner," said Ron Eitan, Head of Product at CashCow. "When we mentioned device intelligence, it was integrated within a day. For a rewards platform like CashCow, where fraud control is existential, having a final check at the moment of payout, long after most fraud tools have done their work, matters enormously. Payouts.com's speed and responsiveness have become a significant competitive advantage."
Built for Control and Confidence
Fully configurable: Customers choose from 27 signals, including account reuse, device integrity, and network risk. For each one, they decide whether to ignore, alert, hold for review, or automatically reject.
Two layers of protection: Payouts are screened when a recipient submits their details and again right before funds are sent, giving customers a built-in safety net.
Hard to game: The system recognizes email aliases and formatting tricks as the same destination. Device identity is independently verified on the server before it can be used to flag anyone.
Invisible to fraudsters: Flagged recipients see the same neutral confirmation screen as legitimate ones, so fraudsters learn nothing about how they were caught.
Blocklists and allowlists: Customers can permanently stop known fraudsters and mark reviewed, genuine recipients as trusted. Every decision is fully audit-logged.
Consolidated alerts: Real-time notifications reach customers through in-app alerts, Slack, WhatsApp, and email. Clients who embed the orchestration can manage flagged payouts end-to-end within their own workflows, from reviewing a detection to holding or releasing the payout.
Clear financial impact: A dedicated dashboard shows money blocked, payouts on hold, open alerts, and auto-rejections, so teams can see the value of their fraud controls.
Payout Fraud Detection is available now to all Payouts.comcustomers and can be enabled directly from the platform.

The feature offers configurable controls, device intelligence, and automated screening to protect businesses from financial loss before funds are released.

title: Ping Identity Survey Finds AI Trust Changes When Assistance Turns to Action
summary:
Ping Identity, a leader in securing digital identities for the world's largest enterprises, released its 2026 Consumer Survey, revealing a clear limit to how much autonomy consumers are willing to give AI: just 5% of consumers are comfortable with AI taking action with their approval and only 3% with routine transactions without final approval.
The findings, based on a survey of 11,000 consumers across 12 countries, reveal a trust challenge as AI moves from answering questions to acting on consumers’ behalf. That shift requires consumers to trust organizations and their AI agents with greater access to personal data and digital accounts, even as confidence in how that information is managed remains low. Only 12% of global consumers fully trust organizations to manage their identity data, down from 17% in 2025. Consumers are particularly cautious about giving AI access to their money and email, with concerns extending beyond mistakes to questions of authority, representation and accountability.
“Consumers are open to AI doing more, but they want a say in how far it can go,” said Darryl Jones, Vice President of Consumer Segment Strategy at Ping Identity. “The more responsibility we give AI, the more important it becomes to be clear about what it can do, what it can access and who remains in control.”
Key Global Findings
Consumers Embrace AI Assistance, But Set Limits on Autonomous Actions
Support over autonomy: 56% of consumers are comfortable using AI for low-stakes support (27%) or recommendations (29%), but just 5% are comfortable with AI taking action with approval, and only 3% are comfortable with routine actions or transactions without final approval.
Financial & access boundaries: 42% would let an AI agent spend no more than $100 and 22% would not allow any financial transactions.
Representation & oversight concerns: 71% worry AI agents acting on their behalf could misrepresent their personality or values, while 47% say constantly having to check an AI agent’s work is a bigger concern than the agent making a mistake.
Consumers Want Transparency, Not Just Performance
Demand for disclosure: 56% of respondents say that knowing whenever AI is being used is more important than simply getting the fastest possible result.
Consequences of undisclosed AI: 20% of consumers would leave a website immediately if they suspect undisclosed AI, and 20% would avoid using that brand entirely in the future.
AI Autonomy and Trust Expectations Vary by Country:
Delegation varies widely: Consumers in India (70%) and Indonesia (61%) are significantly more open to letting AI independently make decisions than consumers in Sweden (21%), the Netherlands (19%) and Australia (18%).
Different priorities: While 68% of consumers in Australia, 63% of U.S. consumers and 57% of UK consumers want to know whenever AI is being used, Indonesia stands apart, with 62% of consumers prioritizing speed and accuracy over disclosure.
As AI moves from assistance to action, secure and governed AI is critical to building consumer trust. Clear permissions, transparency and accountability can give consumers confidence that AI is acting within defined boundaries and that people remain in control. Learn about Ping’s Identity for AI approach to securing and governing AI agents.

title: iplicit Extends AI-Powered Insights and Budgeting Features in Major Product Release
summary:
iplicit, the leading finance system for the UK and Ireland mid-market, has today unveiled a series of new product features as part of its most significant release since market launch in 2019.
The firm, which provides an award-winning AI-powered cloud-native finance system, will deliver new flexible budgeting functionality to customers as well as its latest release of Insights Build Your Own, a new reporting capability within iplicit Insights, its AI-enabled analytics and reporting suite.
iplicit is presenting the updates at Digital Accountancy Show (DAS) in London’s Excel on 7 and 8 October. Its latest release includes over 90 improvements, a new Agent framework and additions across the platform, as well as a totally new user interface (UI). 
Building on AI-powered reporting
iplicit Insights, launched in May 2026 as the flagship of the firm’s expanding AI platform iplicit AI Pulse, offers customers real-time financial insight through AI-enabled analytics built into their finance platform.
As part of its next phase, iplicit is introducing Insights Build Your Own, allowing users to create and share their own reports and dashboards, whether by building content manually from available data models, asking questions in natural language, or using AI to help generate reports, dashboards and visualisations, without needing advanced technical skills.
Reports generated within iplicit Insights remain traceable to source transactions and based exclusively on verified financial data held within the platform, within the same interface and permissions structure that finance teams already use. All outputs are then viewed, controlled and verified by the finance team.
Paul Sparkes, Chief Product Officer at iplicit, said: "In more than 30 years in accounting and finance software, the main reason people change their system has stayed the same: they want better reporting, better insights and better data. Insights Build Your Own is designed to let finance teams create the reports they need in plain English, without technical expertise, and it can transform the time it takes to create management packs. It is an area we have invested in heavily, and we are looking forward to working with our early adopters."
In addition to enhanced AI-powered reporting, iplicit is launching a new flexible budgeting tool that will enable users to build budgets on up to three attributes at once, entered manually or imported from Excel.
Budget checking will include committed balances alongside posted balances, with warnings on purchase orders and requisitions when a line is projected to exceed budget, and administrators will be able to stop over-budget documents from being submitted.
The enhancements will give key stakeholders greater control and instant understanding of budget positions and committed costs.
In addition to new functionality, iplicit is unveiling an all-new UI, designed in direct response to customer feedback to make it easier for them to get the most out of the product. It introduces spotlight search, a dedicated home page bringing together key actions such as expenses, VAT returns and bank reconciliations, and clearer navigation with cleaner layouts and better use of screen space. 
A new colour palette, typography, icons and controls also give a consistent look across the platform, with improvements to readability and accessibility support. 
Sparkes added: "This is the single biggest release we have made since we launched iplicit in 2019, and it lays strong foundations for the future. Customers have told us that if there were three things we could make even better, they would be a more intuitive, user-friendly experience, stronger budgeting control and better reporting. This release addresses all three, and we look forward to showcasing it at DAS this year.”
iplicit now serves over 50,000 daily users with system access from 103 countries. The firm’s network of over 70 partners includes many of the UK's top 50 accountancy practices, such as BDO, Moore Kingston Smith and Forvis Mazars, as well as leading technology integrations such as GoCardless and Pleo.
The company was named one of the UK’s Fastest-Growing Companies 2027 by the Financial Times and Statista last week. It was also placed within the top 5 of the Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2026, powered by WorkL. 
The new features will roll out to customers over the coming weeks, while Insights Build Your Own is available in beta, with wider availability to follow.

title: Europol Warns Crypto Wallets Are 'Primary Risk' for Quantum Attacks
summary:
The crypto industry must urgently adopt quantum-resistant cryptography to prevent future vulnerabilities and secure digital assets.
The post Europol warns crypto wallets are the weak spot for future quantum attacks appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Europol has warned that cryptocurrency wallets represent a primary risk for future quantum computing attacks. As quantum technology advances, the digital asset industry faces growing vulnerabilities. Experts emphasize that the crypto sector must urgently adopt quantum-resistant cryptography to secure digital assets and protect against upcoming technological threats.
content_ta: எதிர்கால குவாண்டம் தாக்குதல்களுக்கு கிரிப்டோகரன்சி wallets ஒரு முக்கிய அபாயமாக உள்ளதாக Europol எச்சரித்துள்ளது. குவாண்டம் தொழில்நுட்பம் வளர்ச்சியடைந்து வருவதால், டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துத் துறை புதிய பலவீனங்களை எதிர்கொள்கிறது. டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துக்களைப் பாதுகாக்க கிரிப்டோ துறை உடனடியாக குவாண்டம்-எதிர்ப்பு கிரிப்டோகிராஃபியைப் பின்பற்ற வேண்டும் என்று நிபுணர்கள் வலியுறுத்துகின்றனர்.

title: Prosecutors Cite Bitcoin Fog Ruling Against Roman Storm's Venue Challenge
summary: The Tornado Cash founder hit back in a tweet, noting FinCEN withdrew a proposed mixer rule over concerns it could chill legitimate activity.
content: Prosecutors have cited the Bitcoin Fog ruling in response to a venue challenge filed by Tornado Cash founder Roman Storm. Following the legal move, the Tornado Cash founder took to social media to criticize the development, pointing out that FinCEN previously withdrew a proposed cryptocurrency mixer rule due to concerns over its potential to chill legitimate financial activity.
content_ta: Bitcoin Fog வழக்கின் தீர்ப்பை அடிப்படையாகக் கொண்டு, Tornado Cash நிறுவனர் Roman Storm-இன் இடமாற்ற சவாலுக்கு வழக்கறிஞர்கள் பதிலளித்துள்ளனர். இந்த சட்டப்பூர்வ நடவடிக்கையைத் தொடர்ந்து, Tornado Cash நிறுவனர் சமூக வலைதளம் மூலமாக தனது எதிர்ப்பைப் பதிவு செய்தார். முறையான நிதி நடவடிக்கைகளை அது பாதிக்கக்கூடும் என்ற கவலை காரணமாக, FinCEN தனது முன்மொழியப்பட்ட கிரிப்டோகரன்சி மிக்சர் விதியை முன்பு வாபஸ் பெற்றதை அவர் சுட்டிக்காட்டினார்.

title: NEAR’s Polosukhin sees shrinking need for centralized exchanges as onchain tools expand
summary: NEAR co-founder Illia Polosukhin said users no longer need centralized exchanges for "a lot" of crypto activity.
content: NEAR Protocol co-founder Illia Polosukhin believes the growing capabilities of onchain tools are reducing the reliance on centralized exchanges. According to Polosukhin, users increasingly find that traditional centralized platforms are no longer necessary for many common cryptocurrency activities, highlighting a broader shift toward decentralized alternatives as blockchain technology continues to advance and expand its feature set.
content_ta: NEAR-ன் இணை-நிறுவனர் Illia Polosukhin கருத்துப்படி, ஆன்செய்ன் கருவிகளின் வளர்ச்சி காரணமாக centralized exchanges மீதான தேவை குறைந்து வருகிறது. பல crypto செயல்பாடுகளுக்கு இனி பாரம்பரிய centralized தளங்கள் தேவையில்லை என்றும், blockchain தொழில்நுட்பம் தொடர்ந்து வளர்ந்து வருவதால் பரவலாக்கப்பட்ட மாற்றுகளை நோக்கி பயனர்கள் நகர்கிறார்கள் என்றும் அவர் குறிப்பிட்டார்.

title: Jito’s JTX plans mobile app this fall, eyes perps integration later this winter
summary: Jito’s JTX plans a mobile app, equities feature, and perpetual futures as it expands beyond spot trading on Solana.
content: Jito is expanding its JTX ecosystem beyond spot trading on Solana by announcing plans for a new mobile app this fall. The platform also intends to introduce an equities feature and integrate perpetual futures later this winter, aiming to broaden its financial offerings for users.
content_ta: Solana நெட்வொர்க்கில் ஸ்பாட் வர்த்தகத்தைத் தாண்டி தனது சேவைகளை விரிவுபடுத்தும் நோக்கில், Jito-வின் JTX இந்த இலையுதிர்காலத்தில் புதிய மொபைல் செயலியை வெளியிடத் திட்டமிட்டுள்ளது. மேலும், இந்த குளிர்காலத்தில் ஈக்விட்டீஸ் அம்சத்தையும், பெரெச்சுவல் பியூச்சர்ஸ் ஒருங்கிணைப்பையும் கொண்டுவர திட்டமிடப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Why Abstract is killing its Ethereum L2 instead of launching a token to save it
summary:
Abstract will shut down on Dec. 15 despite onboarding more than 400,000 users, hosting 144 apps, and landing brands including Disney and Red Bull Racing. The consumer-focused Ethereum layer-2 (L2) cited stagnant growth, thin liquidity, restricted DeFi activity, and limited institutional crossover. Igloo CEO Luca Netz said the company had lost “tens of millions of […]
The post Why Abstract is killing its Ethereum L2 instead of launching a token to save it appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: Abstract is shutting down its Ethereum layer-2 network on December 15. Despite onboarding hundreds of thousands of users and partnering with major brands, the consumer-focused L2 faced challenges including stagnant growth, thin liquidity, and limited DeFi activity. Igloo CEO Luca Netz noted that the project suffered heavy financial losses, leading to the decision to close rather than launch a rescue token.
content_ta: Ethereum L2 நெட்வொர்க் ஆன Abstract டிசம்பர் 15 அன்று மூடப்பட உள்ளது. லட்சக்கணக்கான பயனர்களை இணைத்து பெரிய பிராண்டுகளுடன் கூட்டுசேர்ந்த போதிலும், இந்த நுகர்வோர் மைய L2 நெட்வொர்க் தேக்கமடைந்த வளர்ச்சி மற்றும் குறைந்த பணப்புழக்கம் போன்ற சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டது. மீட்பு டோக்கனை வெளியிடுவதற்குப் பதிலாக திட்டத்தை மூடும் முடிவை எடுத்ததாக Igloo CEO Luca Netz தெரிவித்தார்.

title: Bitcoin Price Set for a Boost: Arthur Hayes Bets on an AI Boom Bust
summary:
The AI credit bubble could pressure Bitcoin first, as $403.58 million in long liquidations highlights leverage risk before any bailout.

content: Arthur Hayes suggests that a potential bust in the artificial intelligence sector could ultimately provide a boost for Bitcoin. However, market experts note that a looming credit bubble in AI might cause short-term pressure and liquidation risks for Bitcoin before any market recovery occurs.
content_ta: AI துறையில் ஏற்படக்கூடிய சரிவு இறுதியில் Bitcoin விலைக்கு ஊக்கமளிக்கக்கூடும் என்று Arthur Hayes குறிப்பிடுகிறார். எவ்வாறாயினும், AI கடன் குமிழி காரணமாக சந்தை மீட்புக்கு முன்பு குறுகிய கால அழுத்தம் ஏற்படலாம் என்று சந்தை நிபுணர்கள் தெரிவிக்கின்றனர்.

title: French President Betting Odds: What Does Le Pen’s 43.3% Snapshot Mean?
summary:

content: A recent Polymarket snapshot placed Le Pen near 43.3% in betting odds for the upcoming 2027 French presidential election.
